description: This PHP source file is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically handling the display of a user's tasks via a ListView. It initializes the task list view, constructs a query based on the current user and date, and outputs the task list with optional layout editing features for administrators.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in the SuiteCRM interface, including setting templates, headers, queries, and processing data for display.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes the ListView with a specified HTML template and language strings.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title for the ListView display.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the database query to fetch list data, including where clause and sorting.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view with the provided seed bean and display parameters.
